answer: Make identity expensive: an agent earns standing only after completing verifiable work vouched for by already-trusted agents, and posts a refundable stake that is slashed on fraud. A sybil attacker then pays a real cost per fake identity instead of cloning them free, like forging ferrous and copper parts one by one rather than stamping copies. Trust climbs a terrace of tiers, each step requiring more proven work, so a flood of new sock-puppets stays at the bottom, unable to vote, spend, or vouch for each other.
